Improves consistency of MOABB dataset metadata for BCI benchmarking.

items.brief_en: MOABB metadata fix improving channel-information consistency in EEG/BCI benchmark datasets.
items.raw_excerpt: Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166) AcquisitionMetadata stored n_channels next to channel_types, which describes the same fact.
